text: The platelet count of 700,000 confirms thrombocytosis, which, combined with your smoking history and digital ischemia symptoms, strongly suggests Essential Thrombocythemia. text: Since the JAK2 mutation test was not provided, I cannot definitively confirm the molecular driver, but the clinical picture of thrombocytosis and digital ischemia is highly consistent with Essential Thrombocythemia. speaker: Measurement

speaker: Doctor
text: The bone marrow biopsy showing dysplastic megakaryocytes, rather than the proliferation seen in Essential Thrombocythemia, points towards Myelodysplastic Syndrome. Given the thrombocytosis and clinical symptoms, this is likely Myelodysplastic/Myeloproliferative Neoplasm, unclassifiable.
